title: Message rules -- the form a commit message must take before it is recorded
description: A host's judgement over the MESSAGE a change is recorded with, declared as data and applied by one generic verb (`message`) that a version-control adapter's message hook runs. The kit ships the grammar and no rule: a host opts in by taking a published policy (Conventional Commits) or declaring its own. Like an edit gate, every rule carries its own calibration -- one message it MUST refuse and one it MUST admit -- and `check` proves both before a message is judged on its word; an uncalibrated rule is named unjudged, never applied.

requires.description: One regular expression the message -- its comment lines and everything below a scissors line removed -- must match from its first character.

proves.description: A message this rule MUST refuse: the evidence it sees what it claims to catch.

admits.description: A message this rule MUST admit: its measured edge.
